examples.english: And so he gave up his soul into the hands of God, the faithful and confessor archbishop, on the ninth day of Athor. And Abba John, Bishop of Terenuti, his spiritual brother, was worthy to place his hands on the eyes (of the saint), as Joseph had placed his hands on the eyes of his father Jacob.
examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 3

examples.coptic: ⲉⲧⲁϥⲓ ⲉⲣⲁⲕⲟϯ ⲁϥⲙⲧⲟⲛ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩ**ⲭⲱ** ⲙⲡⲉϥⲥⲱⲙⲁ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲧⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓϩⲁⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲙⲁⲣⲕⲟⲥ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲕⲟⲧϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϫⲟⲥ ⲉⲑⲣⲟⲩⲓⲛⲓ ⲉⲡⲉϥⲙⲁ ⲛⲓⲥⲁⲁⲕ ⲕⲁⲧⲁⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲧⲁⲙⲟϥ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛⲡϭⲟⲉⲓⲥ .
examples.english: When the archbishop arrived in Alexandria, he fell asleep, and his body was placed in the church of St. Mark, which he had built, and he told them to bring Isaac in his place, as he had been told to do by the Lord.
examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 2

examples.coptic: ⲉϣⲱⲡ ⲁⲓϣⲁⲛⲉⲣϩⲏⲧⲥ ⲙⲫⲓⲣⲓ ⲉⲡⲓϫⲓⲛⲱⲛϧ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ ϯⲛⲁ**ⲭⲁ**ⲟⲩⲧⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲁⲛ ⲉⲁⲓϩⲱⲗ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲛⲧⲁϣⲧⲉⲙⲧⲁⲙⲟⲕ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲓⲧⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛⲛⲓⲃⲁⲕⲓ ⲓⲧⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛⲛⲓϯⲙⲓ ⲓⲧⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛⲡϣⲁϥⲉ ⲓⲧⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛⲧⲁⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛⲟⲩⲕⲟⲩϫⲓ
examples.english: When I begin to tell you the lives of our Fathers, I will omit no place into which I have entered to instruct you—neither those who dwell in cities, nor in villages, nor in the desert, nor those who live only briefly among others.
